environment: Node: real Three geometry / native Canvas / CPU rasterization; DOM inputs simulated. Hiyori visible before/after and fixed-world shading v21; tailored torso, fitted sleeves, collar and skirt; actual browser observations are noted in prototypes/README.md.

checks.name: WebGL-free startup draws genuine depth-buffered 3D and dismisses loading
all four heroes instantiate and all expressions/clothes/hats keep rendering
front side and back turn the actual model through four distinct angles
walk alternates independent legs and flexes knees
dash accelerates travel; diagonal remains normalized
analog cancellation and blur stop movement
face textures attached to curved head surfaces; no sprites
compatibility renderer draws instanced geometry and respects hidden source layers
CPU compatibility renderer preserves the new cel vertex shading
existing economy, learning, input, saves and background builders stay byte-identical
four heroes have an approximately two-head anatomical silhouette
Hiyori torso and legs shorten independently versus v19 with a shallower head and grounded soles
Hiyori bob has balanced side depth and face maps conform closely to the cranial mesh
foot contact shadows follow animated soles, stay flat and fade when lifted in every outfit
world lighting changes on rotation without changing geometry or accumulating darkness
title portraits come from the new 3D rigs in four-pose transparent PNG atlases
all local HTML dependencies exist and no CDN is required
seven Hiyori forelocks hug the forehead instead of projecting forward in profile
tailored chest and back replace the forward belly while preserving v20 head and short legs
sleeve shoulders overlap the torso during walking and open cuffs enclose connected wrists
skirt opens gradually from a narrow waist and has a controlled hem with fitted collar leaves
